intro: The technology and software development sectors faced a concentrated wave of remote code execution attacks between April 14 and May 2, 2026, with five articles documenting critical and high-severity vulnerabilities. Among the top CVEs were CVE-2026-41265 and CVE-2026-5760, both carrying a CVSS score of 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-25874 at 9.3 and CVE-2026-3854 at 8.7. The threat landscape was global in scope, with three critical and two high-severity incidents impacting artificial intelligence and research fields.
